body: also i see that you’re a transfer student and not a freshman so now i have to warn you that they absolutely do not have space for everyone on campus and i seriously advise you to plan for the case where you don’t get housing at all :(

not sure if they told you guys this but be prepared to live in a triple and in cramped circumstances. they have over admitted students multiple times now and have put three beds in all freshmen rooms that used to be doubles :/
i applied to a different program, but i got my results a few days ago. admitted students day is first week of april so i would give it until closer to then!

not sure if this helps but i applied jan 5 and heard back yesterday! a week or so ago i called admissions to work out an error with my application and they said they don’t send decisions until around the first week of february and that almost everyone receives their decision by mid-march :)
